a: Never trust by network location alone; authenticate and authorize every request.
Grant the minimum permissions required for a role or workload.
Layer controls so one failure does not cause total compromise.
Rotate credentials regularly and immediately after suspected leaks.
Scan lockfiles for known CVEs in CI and production images.
SAST analyzes source; DAST probes running apps for vulnerabilities.
A WAF filters common web attacks at the edge or reverse proxy.
Publish security contact and policy at /.well-known/security.txt.
Invite researchers to report vulnerabilities under clear rules and rewards.
